MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari PET Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released PET Exam Date for the posts of Forest Guard and Jail Prahari. This recruitment was released for 1679 posts. Applications for the MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 28 February 2026, to 30 April 2026. The written examination was held on 04 June 2026.
